bucket

Google Cloud Storage bucket containing the source (see Bucket Name Requirements
(https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/bucket-naming#requirements)).

Google Cloud Storage object containing the source.
This object must be a gzipped archive file (.tar.gz) containing source to build.

string (int64 (https://developers.google.com/discovery/v1/type-format)

When the specified storage bucket is a 1st gen function uploard url bucket, this field
